Hi Alice — thanks for the RFP and the clear timeline. I'm looping in Marissa (sales lead) and Sean (sales ops) to scope commercial flexibility and any onboarding concessions. Quick responses to your asks:

- Premium onboarding: we can offer Concierge Onboard (white-glove) for 3 months by default; we will confirm seat counts and a proposal for 6 seats.
- Custom connector: our standard approach is a time-and-materials statement of work for custom connectors; typical engagements fall in 30–50 hours but we will produce a scoped SOW and estimate.
- SLA: 99.9% is feasible for our Dedicated tier; if you require a Private deployment or data residency add-ons that could change pricing.
- Discounts/credits: any onboarding credits or bundled discounts beyond standard playbook require deal desk approval — tagging Sean for that review.

I can get a draft term sheet together today so you have something to review ahead of procurement. Are you able to share the intended procurement PO cadence and whether they expect a single-year or three-year commitment?
